verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs describe a community plugin marketplace with 113+ plugins covering accessibility, code, AI, and design-system tools, and invite designers to use community plugins or build their own on the plugin system. The 2022 community comment that Penpot lacked a plugin system predates these docs and does not contradict them. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of icon and data-filler plugins, independent or hands-on corroboration of marketplace breadth and quality, and evidence that the ecosystem is 'large' (one community comment notes Figma's ecosystem holds most mindshare).

support.subject: As a designer, I can extend the editor from a large plugin community or marketplace — icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers, and more
